title: A StoryBots Christmas
overview: When Bo mistakenly thinks that her friends don't like her gifts, she heads to the North Pole to ask Santa for help making better presents. She learns along the way that Christmas is about far more than just the toys.

title: Centaurworld
overview: Centaurworld follows a war horse who is transported from her embattled world to a strange land inhabited by silly, singing centaurs of all species, shapes, and sizes. Desperate to return home, she befriends a group of these magical creatures and embarks on a journey that will test her more than any battle she's ever faced before.

title: Elmo and Mark Rober's Merry Giftmas
overview: Elmo and his Sesame Street friends work with former NASA engineer turned YouTube star Mark Rober to make special presents for a Merry Giftmas exchange.

title: Holly Hobbie
overview: Holly's a 13-year-old singer-songwriter who's got her best friends and close-knit family by her side, but she's dreaming of ways to save the world - even if it's starting in her own backyard.

title: My Little Pony: Tell Your Tale
overview: The Mane 5 are back! Sunny teams up with her pony pals for more adventures as they live, learn and laugh together in Maretime Bay.

title: Rebel Cheer Squad: A Get Even Series
overview: The old DGM might have left Bannerman School, but their spirit remains, and there is still a need to get even, wrongs must be righted and injustice has to be fought.

title: Ridley Jones
overview: Curious kid Ridley and her friends protect the Museum of Natural History’s treasures and keep its magical secret safe: Everything comes alive at night!

title: Secrets of Summer
overview: A remote Argentine resort revives its wakeboarding competition, drawing in Mexican athlete Steffi, who is determined to uncover a family secret.

title: Super Monsters: Once Upon a Rhyme
overview: From Goldilocks to Hansel and Gretel, the Super Monsters reimagine classic fairy tales and favorite nursery rhymes with a musical, magical spin!

title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again: In the Zone
overview: Ms. Frizzle’s cousin, a pop star, performs worldwide on New Year’s Eve and the class has been invited backstage. When the Bus undergoes a software update during the tour, it starts to glitch and malfunction.

title: StoryBots: Answer Time
overview: Got a question? The StoryBots have an answer! Join curious friends Beep, Boop, Bing, Bang and Bo on fun adventures to find facts for real kids like you.

title: Country Comfort
overview: When an up-and-coming young country singer accepts a job as a nanny with a musical family, she finds the bond she's always missed.

title: Erin & Aaron
overview: A newly blended family and two polar opposite stepsiblings named Erin and Aaron who come together through music.
